outlet: Stevens County official results, August 4, 2026 primary (VoteWA results API; 58 of 58 precincts, as of 2026-09-11)
notes: Stevens County primary results: Auditor Larsen 6,860 (58.19%), Simpson 4,744 (40.24%); Commissioner District No. 2 (district-only primary) Burrows 3,493 (76.77%), Griffin 779 (17.12%), write-in 278 (6.11%); Coroner Waldrop 8,298 (73.0%), Jezerinac 2,911 (25.61%); unopposed Assessor, Clerk, Prosecuting Attorney, Sheriff, Treasurer, LD 7 Pos. 1 and 2; Fire District 6 Prop. 1 passed 359-245.
